gloss: to take advantage of; to multiply

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {乗|じょう}じていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to take advantage of; to exploit (an opportunity or weakness)
definitions.explanation: To seize upon a situation, moment of weakness, or confusion to act in one's favor. Often implies cunning or opportunism.
To perform multiplication. A formal/literary alternative to 掛ける in mathematical contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隙|すき}→隙：10999_suki_gap⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|じょう}じて⟦{逃|に}げた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。
examples.english: I took advantage of an opening and escaped.

examples.japanese: ⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|じょう}じて⟦{泥棒|どろぼう}→泥棒：01688_dorobou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{侵入|しんにゅう}した→侵入する：17343_shinnyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: A thief broke in, taking advantage of the confusion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|じょう}じた⟦{悪質|あくしつ}→悪質：20553_akushitsu⟧な⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
This is a ずる-verb (a variant of ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verbs). Common conjugation uses {乗|じょう}じる (ichidan) rather than {乗|じょう}ずる:
- {乗|じょう}じる・{乗|じょう}じます
- て-form: {乗|じょう}じて
- た-form: {乗|じょう}じた

PATTERN (sense 1):
～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|じょう}じて (taking advantage of ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{隙|すき}→隙：10999_suki_gap⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|じょう}じる (to take advantage of an opening)
- ⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|じょう}じる (to exploit confusion)
- ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|じょう}じる (to seize the opportunity)

SIMILAR WORDS (sense 1):
- ⟦{付|つ}け{込|こ}む→付け込む：10372_tsukekomu⟧: To take advantage of — implies exploiting a weakness in a more calculated way.
- ⟦{便乗|びんじょう}→便乗：07634_binjou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: To take advantage of, to ride on — often implies riding on someone else's success or a trend.
